description: Convert a video file to MP3 audio entirely in your browser. Your file never leaves your device — decoding and MP3 encoding happen locally.

faqs.a: The audio is extracted with your browser's Web Audio decoder and encoded to a real MP3 at 128 kbps using the lamejs encoder.
faqs.q: What MP3 quality do I get?

faqs.a: Most common formats (MP4, WebM, MOV, MKV audio tracks) decode fine in Chrome, Edge and Firefox. If decoding fails, your browser cannot read that file's audio track.
Yes. The MP3 is encoded on your own device — no file is ever uploaded to a server.

howto: Choose a video file from your device.
Click "Convert to MP3" and wait while the audio is decoded and encoded.
Watch the progress — large videos may take a minute or two.
Your .mp3 file downloads automatically when encoding finishes.
title: Video to MP3 Converter
